name: TFM2 Patch Balance Improvement
summary: Fixes an official 0.4.5 weak-intensity selected champion count path that could still produce 2 patched champions.
notes: Adds the official 0.4.5 selected-count path at 0x14126877e to the 4..6 champion-count patch set.
Official 0.4.5 now has 16 exe patches and 3 selected-count paths.
Keeps weak, normal, and strong patch intensities on the same selected champion count range.
